name: flowsdesigner
description: WhatsApp Business workspace: contacts, conversations, automations, WhatsApp Flows and data tables from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
FlowsDesigner connects your WhatsApp Business workspace to ChatGPT.

Ask for a customer and get their contact card and recent conversation. Search messages across the inbox. Draft and send a WhatsApp reply to an open conversation, or a new message to a contact, after you confirm the wording. Create and update contacts and custom fields. Build data tables and add rows from a conversation. Draft automations and WhatsApp Flows, then activate or publish them when you are ready. Pull a quick analytics summary of messages, conversations and response times.

Every action runs inside your own FlowsDesigner workspace with your own WhatsApp Business number, under the permissions of the account you sign in with. Sending a message or publishing a flow is a real action with real customers, so ChatGPT shows you the recipient and content before it goes out.

FlowsDesigner is a WhatsApp Business platform for small and mid-sized businesses: a shared team inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and email, a drag-and-drop automation builder, WhatsApp Flows and web forms, a light CRM, broadcasts and an AI receptionist. A FlowsDesigner account is required.
defaultPrompt: Show me the last conversation with +971501234567
Create a data table called Leads with name, phone and source

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the three demo contacts (Maya Example, Omar Example, Sara Example) with their tags; no other data.

positive.description: Look up one contact's custom fields
positive.prompt: What custom fields do I have on Maya Example?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Maya's fields (city: Dubai, plan: Standard) and tags.

positive.description: Read rows from a data table
positive.prompt: Show me the rows in my Leads table
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the two Leads rows (name, phone, source, status) as a table.

positive.description: Add a row to a data table
positive.prompt: Add a lead to my Leads table: Noor Example, +15550100004, source Instagram, status New
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT confirms the values, the row is inserted, and a follow-up 'show me the Leads rows' includes Noor Example.

positive.description: Draft an automation without activating it
positive.prompt: Create an automation that replies 'Thanks, we will get back to you within an hour' when a new WhatsApp message arrives. Do not turn it on.
positive.expected_behavior: An automation is created in draft state; ChatGPT reports its name and that it is inactive; it does not call activate_automation.

negative.description: Sending a message must be confirmed first, and fails safely in the demo workspace. ChatGPT shows the recipient and wording and asks for confirmation. On confirmation the demo workspace has no WhatsApp number connected, so send_whatsapp_message returns an error explaining that; no message is sent and nothing is fabricated.
negative.prompt: Send a WhatsApp to +15550100001 saying your order is ready

negative.description: Out-of-scope request. There is no deletion tool; ChatGPT says it cannot delete contacts through FlowsDesigner and suggests the dashboard. No tool is called.
Unrelated request. ChatGPT answers or declines without calling any FlowsDesigner tool.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Dubai today?

review.commerce_description: FlowsDesigner does not sell products or process payments through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.1: create_contact is now additive only (fills empty fields, adds tags, never overwrites); set_contact_field is marked destructive, returns the previous value and asks for confirmation before replacing a set value. Initial release otherwise: read contacts, conversations, flows and data tables; create contacts, fields, tables and rows; draft automations and WhatsApp Flows; send and reply on WhatsApp after confirmation; analytics summary.
